parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/MP3StreamerTests/AudioEnginePlayerTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity is high (0.909), `testPlay` and `testPlayIdempotent` are intentionally distinct test cases: one verifies basic play behaviour and the other verifies idempotency of repeated play invocations. These are load-bearing test fixtures whose near-duplication reflects shared setup boilerplate rather than accidental redundancy. Merging or extracting them would obscure test intent and couple unrelated assertions.
